name: xai_retirement_find_retired_xai_refs
notes: Retired-xAI config scan (src/xai_retirement.c::hermes_xai_find_retired/check_slot walk vs LIVE hermes_cli/xai_retirement.py::find_retired_xai_refs). Input encodes 4 model slots (principal/delegation/aux.vision/aux.curator; empty=unset). Covers: empty config, non-xAI models, prefix/case/whitespace normalization (x-ai/, xai/, uppercase, padded), retired matches in every slot, reasoning_effort=none variants, and near-miss grok names. Dropped inputs (documented table divergence, not traced): 'grok-3' (LIVE-retired, C table lacks it) and 'grok-4'/'grok-4-fast'/'grok-4-1-fast' (C table has them, LIVE does not) — the C retired-model table is NOT in lock-step with LIVE _RETIRED_MODELS; input 10 exercises 'grok-3' only as a looks-like-xAI non-match (no table hit on either side). Also LIVE walks tts.xai.model and plugins.image_gen.xai.model slots which the C config walk does not have; those slots are left unset in every input.
